text.text_excerpt: I have been to the Civic Theater twice in the past month, and I really like it! It's an absolutely lovely place, first and foremost-- high ceilings, modern architecture and flashy but subdued wallpaper. There are a few bars located throughout the venue-- not exactly cheap, but they've got beer, liquor and wine so it's good for me! It's standing room, unless you've got a VIP pass then there's a really attractive balcony area. The floor is very unsturdy and wobbly, so when people start jumping around it can be kind of crazy! I saw Russell Brand at The Civic! Ok, now to review the venue and not Russell. Let me think. Got it! First and foremost, one thing I immediately loved is the fact that parking is a cinch. There is a parking lot right across the street, so parking is painless and there wasn't a long walk so I felt super safe. I got in line before the doors opened, and although there was a bit of wait, everything was handled pretty quickly and we were in in no time. The bar is there immediately when you walk in and the bartenders did a good job of keeping up with the crowd. I recently went to a Empire of the Sun concert at the Civic Theater and really enjoyed myself. -The architecture is awesome. As the oldest theater in New Orleans it is a beautiful historical building that has been preserved well over the years. -The show I went to was general admission only. I loved how the floor was for standing room only for the twerk generation to show off their newest cat shirt, jump up and down and get all sweaty to the sick beatz.
